# CheckNumber RCS Number Checker API
> Official integration context generated from the checked API expansion manifest.

## Canonical resources
- [rcs](https://docs.checknumber.ai/rcs-checker)

## Contract facts
- API base URL: https://api.checknumber.ai
- Authentication: `X-API-Key` request header
- API key environment variable: `CHECKNUMBER_API_KEY`
- Processing mode: async_bulk
- Current prices are not embedded; use the official pricing page.

## Products
- `rcs`: Number Checker · input `phone` · fields: number, activated, system

## Safety
- Process only identifiers you are authorized to verify.
- Do not expose API keys in browser code or commit secrets.
- An undetermined result is not a confirmed negative.

Last reviewed: 2026-10-30.


## Upload and billing limits verified 2026-10-30

| Task type | Minimum upload | Maximum upload | Minimum billable quantity |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `rcs` | 1 | 10,000,000 | 500 |

Upload minimum and minimum billable quantity are different. A smaller accepted upload can still be billed at the stated minimum. Zero means no billing floor. A wholly failed/unprocessed task is not charged a fabricated minimum. Check current account pricing before submitting.
